title: skills(objectstack-i18n) + docs: teach the translation bundle's packages group (a package's display name and description per locale, from #35513)
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Blocked-by: #37933

## Why this matters

#35513 (PR #37933) adds a `packages` group to the translation bundle. It holds `packages: { MANIFEST_ID: { name, description } }` per locale, and Setup › 软件包 and the Studio package switcher show the package's name in the user's language from it. After that release, a stack that declares a non-default language without the package name gets two `i18n/missing-package` warnings per language. Agents and authors learn the bundle's shape from skills/objectstack-i18n and the translation docs, and none of them mention the new group yet. So an author who meets the new warning has nothing to follow, and an agent writing a translation pack leaves the group out. PR #37933's body names this as its owed `Skills-docs:` follow-up.

## Where

- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`, which describes the bundle groups and has no `packages` group.
- `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` and `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx`, which list the bundle groups.

## Acceptance

- The skill and both pages teach the `packages` group: its key is the manifest id, it holds `name` and `description`, and the console falls back to `manifest.name` when the group has no entry. Each also names the `i18n/missing-package` warning and how to clear it.
- The shape taught is the one #37933 merges (read `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` at the merge commit), and any example passes the skill example checks.
- The skill's token-ratchet row moves only by its measured delta.

## Out of scope

`os validate` checking `packages` keys against the known manifest ids, which is the other open question in #37933's report, is a separate card if the L2 review keeps it open.
